comments: SysWisdom AI LLC builds accessibility evaluation tools for public colleges and other public-sector organizations preparing for the ADA Title II rule. The tool reports findings only. It does not modify or overlay pages, and every report requires a named human reviewer to sign off. - aj@syswisdom.ai
features: Free online scan of a web page or AI chatbot, built on axe-core. Runs automated WCAG 2.0 and 2.1 A and AA rules plus WCAG 2.2 AA rules, and opens the chat window to test it. Lists manual checks for your staff. Never claims conformance. Self-hosted agent available.
title: SysWisdom AI Quality Agent
